categories.name: Fortresses
categories.blurb: A Fortress: a heavily guarded stronghold with tougher enemies and better loot.

categories.name: Compounds
categories.blurb: An enemy Compound: a fortified military position inside a normal building, with a guard force and loot to match.

categories.name: Lieutenant Towers
categories.blurb: Climb a Lieutenant Hunt tower to reveal the nearest Lieutenant boss on your map.

categories.name: UAV Towers
categories.blurb: Activate a UAV Tower to see enemies on your minimap for a while.

categories.name: Key Rooms
categories.blurb: A locked room. Find its key in Hajin (keys can drop from Lieutenants) and bring it here; the key's description names its grid square.

categories.name: Ammo & Armor Caches
categories.blurb: Ammo & Armor Cache: refill ammo and plates. It goes on cooldown after use.

categories.name: Fire Stations
categories.blurb: Fire Stations are the place for radiation gear and parachutes, which you need for the Nuclear Reactor and high drops.

categories.name: Police Stations
categories.blurb: Police Stations carry military gear, with a locked Armory inside.

categories.name: Marine Gas Stations
categories.blurb: Marine Gas Station: refuel boats here.

markers.name: 14th Political Prison
markers.note: A walled prison on a cleared plateau in the North Korean wilderness. Watchtowers on every corner, barracks on the east side and the main gate to the south. The Citadel Fortress sits inside the yard.

markers.name: Chang-san Air Base
markers.note: A North Korean air base cut into a granite hillside, with an underground bunker bigger than the base above it. Cliffs guard the east side; the woods to the south are the usual way in. The outside is Critical, the bunker Extreme. Lieutenant Bale holds the Tank Depot in the bunker.

markers.name: Deadtown
markers.note: An empty farming town taken over by the army, with toxic rivers to the northwest and east and sewers running under the main buildings. Light resistance and street fights; the two Re-Education Centers hold the better targets.

markers.name: Imjin Farmland
markers.note: Flat rice fields, waterways and rail lines on the southwest border, with the Rice Mill Fortress in the middle. Long sightlines and little cover, so move carefully or use a vehicle.

markers.name: Cheongun Village
markers.note: A gambling town on the Hajin River with border crossings into Russia to the east and west. Expressway No. 1 runs along its south edge. The Heavenly Luck Casino Fortress dominates it.

markers.name: Haneul Nuclear Reactor
markers.note: A radioactive cloud hangs over the whole site and gets worse inside the reactor. Bring radiation gear and a gas mask; Radiation Blockers help. Fire Stations are where to find the gear.

markers.name: Mirae General Hospital
markers.note: Hajin's main hospital, next to a train station with The Grid and the mall to the east. Triage tents and barracks outside, close-quarters fights through the wards inside. Snipers like the woods of Mujin Pass to the south. Also a Fortress.

markers.name: NuriGo Mall
markers.note: A shopping district under the city's towers: police station, clinic, City Hall, a monorail stop and car parks. Three round structures in the main courtyard lead down to a huge dark underground mall (bring NVGs), which is the NuriGO Mall Fortress. Lieutenant Jang-ui camps here. West is High threat, East Medium.

markers.name: Cheonwang Peak Array
markers.note: Hajin's biggest telecom array on a flat summit, now an enemy base. Boulder trails to the west, gentler woods north toward Mujin Pass. The roof has a helipad and long views.

markers.name: The Grid
markers.note: The walled, razor-wired heart of Hajin City: barricaded streets, watchtowers and roaming patrols. Includes Donpyeong Gate, Hanex Bank, the DBN TV tower (the tallest building in Hajin) and the red-roofed Nenshin Tech Complex, which is Extreme threat.

markers.name: Songdo Wharf
markers.note: A quieter waterfront between the reactor and the river, with working train and monorail lines. The La Grande Vie tower is the tallest building nearby; a market, pier, lighthouse and Oamsik Turtle Island are on the coast.

markers.name: Wolves Stadium
markers.note: A ruined baseball stadium with a collapsed apartment tower beside it, an open-air theatre to the north and a police station and bank in the streets around. The edge with The Grid to the north is the dangerous part.

markers.name: Hajin River Heights
markers.note: Battered apartments and narrow shopping streets south of the stadium, rising toward the river's south fork. One apartment block is Compound Echo; Jinseo Park Towers and South Island's comms tower are further south.

markers.name: Hanrim Village
markers.note: Lieutenant Gorani, a ghillie-suited sniper, hunts from the woods above this village.

markers.name: The Citadel
markers.note: A Y-shaped Fortress inside the prison yard: gantries, cell blocks and a furnace, with high-value targets throughout. Easy to get cut off, so learn the layout. Critical threat.

markers.name: Heavenly Luck Casino
markers.note: A multi-floor casino with an underground car park. No power, so the gambling halls are dark mazes: bring NVGs. High threat.

markers.name: Mirae General Hospital
markers.note: The hospital itself is a Fortress: expect close-quarters fights through the wards and lobby.

markers.name: Admin Complex No. 2
markers.note: The command Fortress at Chang-san Air Base. Extreme threat.

markers.name: Re-Education Center
markers.note: Two central buildings in Deadtown where enemy numbers build up. The town around them has a Clinic and a Gas Station at each end.

markers.name: Rice Mill
markers.note: A Fortress on high ground over the farmland. Use the warehouses as cover on the way in, watch for enemy vehicles in the open, and switch to close-range weapons inside.

markers.name: NuriGO Mall
markers.note: The underground mall beneath the NuriGO courtyard: a sprawling, unlit shopping level. Bring NVGs. The Warden's key opens a sealed door down here.

markers.name: Vault Armory
markers.note: Epic key, grid F4. Opens the small armory in the casino's underground car park.

markers.name: Imjin Mill Foreman's Office
markers.note: Rare key, grid D8. Opens the foreman's office on the first floor of the Rice Mill.

markers.name: The Citadel South Wing
markers.note: Uncommon key. Opens the South Wing of the Citadel inside the prison.

markers.name: Re-Education Center Annex
markers.note: Epic key, grid B7. Opens the annex on the ground floor of the Re-Education Center in Deadtown.

markers.name: Iskra's Control Room
markers.note: Legendary key, grid F7. Opens the control room on the upper floor of the broadcast building.

markers.name: Air Base DRC Weapons Locker
markers.note: Ultra key, grid B6. Opens the DRC Weapons Locker in the secure armory deep in the Chang-san Air Base bunker.

guide.title: Bosses
guide.intro: Lieutenants drop lots of cash, a Dog Tag (picking it up shows your position), sometimes a Key and rarely their weapon. Commanders roam the map; the first kill of each pays cash, and extracting after a kill gives ingredients. Tick a boss once you've taken it down.

rows.title: Gorani
rows.subtitle: Ghillie-suited sniper in the woods above Hanrim Village. Uses an M4.

rows.title: Bale
rows.subtitle: Tank Depot in the Chang-san Air Base bunker. Bale's Dog Tag (Legendary) marks you for nearby squads until you extract. Carries the Dreadnought, a Legendary LMG worth about $16,000.

guide.title: Traits
guide.intro: Each operator has three trees: Warfighter, Scout and Survivalist. You pick one trait per row, 9 per tree and 18 at most, with points from levelling your operator's dog tag (about 1,900 XP a point at Silver). The two-choice rows are fixed; the three-choice rows are random for each operator and show once you take a trait from the row below (trees are climbed from the bottom). Scout is shown as seen on Ghost; tap any trait to see what it does.
